# Admetus Lifesciences
> Precision softgel capsule manufacturer in Haryana, India. WHO-GMP, FSSAI, GMP, HACCP, Halal certified. Contract manufacturing, private label, third party manufacturing, and export to 44 countries across Africa, Middle East, Southeast Asia, Central Asia, and South Asia.

## Company
- Founded: 2020 by Anudeep Deswal
- Location: Village Anta, Tehsil Safidon, District Jind, Haryana 126112, India
- Contact: team@admetuslifesciences.com | +91-9729977795
- Certifications: FSSAI, GMP, HACCP, Halal, WHO-GMP
- Equipment: ARBES SGX-806P encapsulation, Elmach EPI 2000 blister packing
- Products: 80+ softgel capsule formulations
